title: Alien propulsion via electromagnetic energy and time
summary: Dan Sherman tells of Alien propulsion via electromagnetic energy and time, about early 1990s at Base 2, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says he was hired by the National Security Agency, the US electronic spying agency, to communicate with aliens, told podcast host Jesse Michels about what he learned in the early 1990s at a place he calls Base 2. He says the way the aliens' craft moved had to do with electromagnetic energy and time, and he brings up Bob Lazar, a man known for his own claims about alien craft, in the same breath.
